title: Build check tests match the code and CI: release cards switch on by a release entry, photo fixture carries the label shape
steps: S1: In a temporary tree with a task note and a task folder without release, ask holdsReleases; then add a dangling tasks/<x>/release link and ask again, and run checkCards.
S2: Run the photo-selection test of the residue sweep with labelled photos.
expect: S1: false, then true; checkCards reports exactly 'tasks/dangling/release is not a directory'.
S2: food, a room or the building come before a video frame, a blurry one or a face; none is dropped.
evidence: 27/10/2026: build check (checks, tests 1/2, tests 2/2, tests e2e) failed on every PR into develop with 'only 0 release cards found' and the photo-selection deep-equal mismatch
fence: The switch-on condition of the release-card repository checks and the photo label fixture

cmd: --test-name-pattern=malformed release|task folder that is a link|best photo first
tests: a malformed release still switches the repository checks on: a dangling link is a release to report
a task folder that is a link is walked like a real one: its release switches the checks on and is read
a frame takes the best photo first: food, a room or the building before a video frame, a blurry one or a face; none is dropped
